title: Sean McVay reveals Alaric Jackson’s next move after NFL suspends Rams star for throwing punch

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean McVay reveals Alaric Jackson’s next move after NFL suspends Rams star for throwing punch
sources.description: Rams coach Sean McVay confirms Alaric Jackson plans to appeal his two-game NFL suspension for punching Bills linebacker Bradley Chubb after Monday's loss.
